photo.alt: Central Ulaanbaatar with the Blue Sky Tower

facts: About 1.6 million people (2022), almost half of the country
About 1,300 m up, in a valley on the Tuul River
worth_knowing: Founded in 1639 as a nomadic Buddhist monastic centre, it moved 29 times before settling at its present site in 1778. It took the name Ulaanbaatar in 1924, when it became the capital.
